description: This file defines the IRepository interface within the ApplicationCore.Interfaces namespace for the eShopOnWeb project. The interface extends a generic base repository interface, providing an abstraction for data repositories with type parameter T constrained to be a class implementing IAggregateRoot.

classes.name: IRepository<T>
classes.description: A generic repository interface extending IRepositoryBase with a type constraint that T must be a class and implement IAggregateRoot.
